title: RAS 2026 node.csv row
description: Schema for one row of node.csv. Each CSV row, parsed with appropriate column types, must validate against this schema. See spec v1.5 §3.1.

node_type.description: Node category. Only 'yard' rows participate as commodity endpoints and as classification points.

name.description: Display name (e.g., 'AUBURN', 'MEMPHIS'). Empty for non-yard nodes.

yard_type.description: For yards only: 'hump' (Class I bowls), 'major_flat' (regional flat sorting), 'intermodal' (ramp-typed), or 'local' (industry-serving). Blank for non-yard nodes.

yard_level.description: Yard-size hierarchy: 1 = Class I super-humps; 2 = major-flat regional; 3 = local. 0 for non-yard nodes.

railroad_id.description: Owning railroad: UP, BNSF, CSX, NS, CN, CPKC, or a placeholder for shared/non-yard nodes.

num_tracks.description: Maximum number of outbound CLASSIFICATION (Manifest/Bulk) blocks the yard can build per operating cycle. Per v1.5 §2.2 C2: not consumed by intermodal/multilevel blocks.

handling_capacity.description: Maximum cars classified at this yard per operating cycle (C3). Pass-through traffic does not count.

handling_cost.description: Per-car classification handling cost at this yard.

is_interchange.description: TRUE if the yard is a designated multi-railroad interchange point.

allowed_commodities.description: Comma-separated list of commodities the yard can classify (advisory). Operative restriction is in spec §1.1 / C2.

allowed_traversal.description: Always 'all' in v1.5; reserved for future per-mode restrictions.

datasource.description: Provenance note for this row's parameter values.
